full_name: Phillip Warnell | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Kingston University London (United Kingdom)
bio: Phillip Warnell is an artist-filmmaker, a writer, and the director of the Visible Institute, for research in film and photography, at Kingston University, London. He produces film works and texts exploring a range of philosophical and poetic thematics, also exploring ideas on human-animal relations.
